blocks.source: １９９６年４月５日発売。つまり、ＳＦＣ後期というか、もはや末期の作品。ＳＦＣのスクウェア作品の中では知名度で劣るが、完成度は悪くない。
blocks.translation: Released on April 5, 1996. In other words, it was released late in the SFC's lifespan—practically at the end of it. Although it is less well-known than other Square titles on the SFC, its overall quality is not bad.

blocks.source: ４０００年の周期で支配種族が交代してきた歴史を持つ世界。『ルドラ』というのは、その度に世界を支配する種族を滅ぼし、自分の種族による新しい時代を築く役目を持っている。という具合に、世界設定はＳＦ要素も混じって壮大。そして、物語は人類の滅亡まで後１６日という所で始まる。
blocks.translation: This is a world with a history of its ruling species changing every 4,000 years. The “Rudra” are responsible for wiping out whichever species rules the world each time and establishing a new era ruled by their own species. As such, the world-building is grand in scale, incorporating science-fiction elements as well. The story begins with only 16 days remaining until humanity's extinction.

blocks.source: ３人の主人公（シオン、サーレント、リザ）の中から、好きなキャラクターを選んで話を進めるという形式が特徴。セーブをすればいつでも、切り替えることができるので、１人ずつ一気に進めるも良し。バラバラに進めるも良し。
blocks.translation: The game is distinguished by its format: you choose your favorite character from among the three protagonists (Sion, Surlent, and Riza) and advance their story. You can switch between them at any time after saving, so you can either progress through each story in one go or advance through them separately.

blocks.source: ちなみに『滅亡まで後１６日』という設定だが、時間制限の様なモノはなく、ストーリーを進行しない限り日付は進まない。要するに単なる進行度なので、安心してプレイできる。
blocks.translation: Incidentally, although the game is set to have “16 days until extinction,” there is no actual time limit, and the date does not advance unless you progress the story. In other words, it is simply a measure of your progress, so you can play without worry.

blocks.source: ある主人公で取った行動が、他の主人公にも影響を与えることがある。とはいえ、さほど複雑な構成ではなく、影響があるのは一部のイベントのみ。
blocks.translation: Actions taken by one protagonist can sometimes affect the others. That said, the structure is not particularly complex, and only certain events are affected.

blocks.source: ストーリーテンポは良好。シオン編、リザ編のストーリーは王道で手堅い。個人的に最も印象が強かったのはサーレント編。目まぐるしいストーリー展開で、サーレントが悲惨な目に会いまくる。
blocks.translation: The story moves at a good pace. Sion's and Riza's stories are classic and solid. The one that personally left the strongest impression on me was Surlent's story. The plot develops at a dizzying pace, and Surlent keeps getting dragged into one miserable situation after another.

blocks.source: ３人分の物語をクリアすることで、最終章に移ることになる。
blocks.translation: After clearing all three protagonists' stories, you move on to the final chapter.

blocks.source: 付けた名前によって魔法の効果が決定される言霊システムが独創的。ケアルやデジョンなど、ＦＦにあった魔法の名前を付けると、ちゃんとそれっぽい効果になる。スクウェア時代の作品にも関わらず、ホイミやメガンテなどＤＱの呪文にも対応しているのが笑える。ちなみに、女神転生とかで試してみたけど駄目だった。
blocks.translation: The Word of Power system, in which the effects of magic are determined by the name you give it, is highly original. If you give it the name of a spell from FF, such as Cure or Dezone, it produces a suitably similar effect. Despite being a Square-era title, it is amusing that it also supports DQ spells such as Hoimi and Kamikazee. Incidentally, I tried names from Shin Megami Tensei and such, but they did not work.

blocks.source: このシステムを使用すると、最初から強力な言霊を使用できる。序盤のボスなら数ターンで瞬殺することも可能となってしまうが、消費ＭＰも高いので、それなりにバランスは取れている。ただし、最初から攻略情報を知った上、効率優先で言霊を作ると、味気ないゲームだと感じてしまうかもしれない。
blocks.translation: Using this system allows you to use powerful Kotodama from the very beginning. You may even be able to instantly defeat early-game bosses in just a few turns, but they also have high MP costs, so the system is reasonably well balanced. However, if you know the strategy information from the start and create Kotodama with efficiency as your top priority, you may find the game bland.

blocks.source: 戦闘は普通のターン制。何気に行動順序の並び替えができたりするのは、この時代では珍しい要素かも。筆者はこれに終盤まで気付かなかったが……。
blocks.translation: Battles use a standard turn-based system. The ability to rearrange the order of actions is a surprisingly uncommon feature for a game from this era. I did not notice it until near the end, though...

blocks.source: ぶっちゃけると、言霊システムにはそれほど深みがあるわけではない。けれど、それを抜きにしてもゲームバランスは手堅く、ＲＰＧとして意外に完成度が高い。特にラスボスは良い言霊を作成しておかないと手強い。
blocks.translation: To be frank, the Word of Power system is not particularly deep. Even without it, however, the game is well balanced and surprisingly polished as an RPG. The final boss is especially tough if you have not created some good Words of Power.

blocks.source: スクウェアの作品らしく全体的に快適設計。戦闘では、攻撃の度に敵に近寄るタイプなのだが、テンポを損なってはおらずスピーディ。
blocks.translation: As befits a Square title, the game is comfortable to play overall. In battle, characters move toward enemies each time they attack, but this does not hurt the pacing, and battles remain fast-paced.

blocks.source: 欠点を言えば、メッセージはボタンを押しっぱなしにしないと高速送りできないこと。ウリのシステムである言霊の整頓ができないことが挙げられる。
blocks.translation: As for drawbacks, messages cannot be fast-forwarded unless you hold down the button. You also cannot organize the Words of Power, which are the game's signature system.

blocks.source: ＳＦＣ末期かつスクウェア作品とくれば、グラフィックの質は保証されている。美麗なドット絵なのにも関わらず、敵味方ともに動きにアニメーションが存在する。言霊の戦闘アニメも豊富。
blocks.translation: When a game is both a late-SFC title and a Square release, you can expect high-quality graphics. Despite using beautiful pixel art, both enemies and allies have animated movements. There are also plenty of battle animations for the Words of Power.

blocks.source: 作曲者は笹井隆司氏。サガ３やミスティッククエスト（ＦＦＵＳＡ）等、スクウェアの微妙ゲーの担当（失礼？）として有名。ルドラは微妙ゲーでは断じて無いが知名度的には不遇。とはいえ、曲のクオリティはＳＦＣのスクウェア作品の中でも屈指の高水準。ＦＦやロマサガにだって、決して引けを取らない。
blocks.translation: The composer was Takashi Sasai. He is famous for working on Square's less highly regarded games (no offense?) such as SaGa 3 and Mystic Quest (FFUSA). Rudra is by no means a mediocre game, but it has been treated unfairly in terms of name recognition. Even so, the music is among the highest quality of any Square title on the SFC. It certainly does not fall short of FF or Romancing SaGa.

blocks.source: 通常戦闘曲を始めとして、戦闘曲全般のノリが非常にいい。章毎にフィールド曲やボス戦曲が違うが、いずれも高品質。町やダンジョンの曲もバリエーション豊か。印象に残るメロディが多い。
blocks.translation: The battle music in general has a fantastic energy, starting with the standard battle theme. The field and boss battle themes differ from chapter to chapter, but all of them are high quality. The town and dungeon music also offers plenty of variety. There are many memorable melodies.
